claims.claim: Trafilatura supports main-text extraction, metadata, structural elements such as lists/code/tables and multiple output formats.
claims.notes: Exact behavior depends on version and extraction options.

claims.claim: Trafilatura uses its own rule-based extractor with jusText and readability-lxml as fallback methods.
claims.notes: Do not present this as a fixed universal sequence without checking the installed version and mode.

claims.claim: FineWeb reports that its WARC plus Trafilatura extraction outperformed WET text in a controlled data ablation with fastText English filtering and no deduplication.
claims.notes: This is not a general benchmark of all extraction libraries.

claims.claim: Extraction quality should be evaluated against a representative manually annotated set using precision and recall, with structure and metadata tracked separately.
claims.notes: Recommended evaluation protocol synthesized from information-retrieval metrics and the extractor's documented output types.
